reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: Love how it cleans away dead skin cells. But after a while my skin feels like it burns and is a bit uncomfortable. You just get used to it. I love the baby skin feeling after I use it!!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢可以清走死皮。但用咗一陣皮膚會覺得拮住有啲唔舒服。用耐咗就會習慣。用完之後塊面好似 BB 肌嗰種感覺我好鍾意！！

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating Black Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: I had high expectations for this one, but it was just okay for me. It’s not a bad product and feels gentle on the skin, but I didn't see the dramatic "peel" results I was hoping for. It’s a decent, mild exfoliant, but I’m not sure I’d repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我對呢個產品期望好高，但對我嚟講只係一般。唔算差嘅產品，感覺對皮膚都好溫和，但我冇見到我期待嗰種明顯嘅「去角質」效果。算係唔錯、溫和嘅去角質產品，但唔確定會唔會回購。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating Black Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: It’s okay overall. The texture is comfortable and it doesn’t irritate my skin. It leaves my skin feeling clean and slightly smoother after use. Nothing dramatic, but a decent product that does its job.
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講仲可以。質地舒服，又唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。用完之後皮膚感覺清爽，滑咗少少。冇咩明顯效果，但算係一個做好本分嘅唔錯產品。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: Приобрела чтоб избавиться от закрытых комедонов, после первого использования, подбородок очень гладкий, по бокам щек тоже немного более гладкое, буду продолжать
reviews.zh: 買咗係為咗處理閉鎖式粉刺，第一次用完之後，下巴變得好滑，兩邊面頰都滑咗少少，會繼續用。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating Black Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: i put in my face i put in on the back of my neck , armpits to remove that dead skin that accumulates in those places and it not harsh on the skin but can remove that dead skin
reviews.zh: 我搽上面，搽喺後頸、腋下，等佢清除嗰啲積聚嘅死皮，但唔會對皮膚嚟講好刺激，同時又清除到死皮。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: Thought this product was just a hype, but it is truly amazing! Felt my skin dry up a little bit afterwards, but used purely hydrating and barrier strengthening toners/ serum for a day, and my glow was complete
reviews.zh: 本來以為呢個產品只係吹捧，但真係超好用！用完之後皮膚覺得有少少乾，但用咗一整天純保濕同強化屏障嘅爽膚水／精華之後，光澤感就出晒嚟。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: So I saw that these have been viral on TikTok but I didn’t trust the authenticity of the item. So I bought both here on OY to try. I like them! I use them before I do a full face of makeup up and they make my makeup last so much longer and look so much smoother! It’s a little gimmicky as it IS THE PRODUCT BALLING UP! NOT DEAD SKIN! The product balls up and becomes a physical exfoliant! They still work amazingly though! But don’t let the people on TikTok lie to you and say it’s dead skin! But don’t get me wrong! I really like them both!!!!
reviews.zh: 喺 TikTok 見到呢啲產品好紅，但我唔太信佢哋係真嘅。所以兩支都喺 OY 買咗返嚟試。我幾鍾意！我會喺化全妝之前用，妝可以keep得耐好多，望落亦滑好多！有少少 gimmick，因為其實係產品自己結咗粒粒！唔係死皮！產品結粒粒就變成物理去角質！不過效果真係好好！不過唔好畀 TikTok 嗰啲人呃到你話係死皮！但唔好誤會我！兩支我都好鍾意！！！！

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule 80ml
reviews.text: I tried it for the first time today and it really works. It exfoliated the dead skin off my face and left it feeling very soft. Didn’t irritate or dry my skin
reviews.zh: 今日第一次試，真係 work。去到面上嘅死皮，用完皮膚摸落好軟。冇刺激到皮膚，亦冇令皮膚覺得乾。
